description: This file defines a dictionary of canned responses for a bot and a class 'ProbotMessenger' that sends messages using these responses via a function 'send_update_to_probot'. It is part of a backend service for handling bot notifications related to repository processing and bug localization.

classes.name: ProbotMessenger
classes.description: A class responsible for sending formatted messages to a GitHub bot or similar service, utilizing predefined canned responses.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ProbotMessenger with repository info and optional comment ID.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Formats and sends a message based on a key and optional parameters to the bot via 'send_update_to_probot'.
